svg.aria-label: How Daedalus answers a question: the dashboard sends it to FastAPI, intent is classified, a safety guard refuses control requests, deterministic tools read the read-only sensor database (or Track 1 / Track 2 search the knowledge base), an evidence pack goes to the local Ollama model, a validator checks every number, and a cited answer streams back
svg.text: daedalus · how one question is answered

g.text: <you> what is the current co2 concentration and reactor temperature?
<you> intent = live_status → sensor tools, not the knowledge base
<you> not a control request → go on ("open valve ABV-1" stops here)
<you> qwen3:1.7b phrases only the evidence · 38.3 s
